decisions.reason: The quote states 'All patients had a genetic diagnosis of CLN7 with homozygous or compound heterozygous mutations in the MFSD8 gene.' This directly establishes that MFSD8 mutations cause CLN7 disease. The causal relationship is implicit in the genetic diagnosis statement combined with the study design establishing these patients have CLN7 due to MFSD8 mutations.

The quoted phrase 'neurological events including seizures and neurodevelopmental regression' explicitly lists seizures as a clinical feature of CLN7 disease. The grammatical subject (patients with CLN7) makes clear that seizures are a phenotype of the disease.

The quote 'Language problems were noted prior to or at the onset of seizures in all cases' directly establishes that language problems are a clinical phenotype present in CLN7 patients. The statement is about patients with CLN7 disease and their observed language problems.

The quote 'Gait problems were noted prior to seizure onset in 3 of 8 patients, and at or within 6 months after the onset of seizures in 5 of 8 patients' directly describes gait problems as an observed clinical phenotype in the CLN7 patient cohort.

The quote 'All patients followed a progressive course of language, motor, and neurocognitive deterioration' lists 'motor' deterioration as part of the disease progression. Motor decline is a reasonable interpretation of motor deterioration and clearly refers to a phenotype of CLN7 disease.

The quote 'All patients followed a progressive course of language, motor, and neurocognitive deterioration' explicitly mentions neurocognitive deterioration as a progressive phenotype of CLN7 disease. Cognitive impairment is a direct interpretation of neurocognitive deterioration.

The quote 'neurological events including seizures and neurodevelopmental regression' explicitly lists neurodevelopmental regression as a clinical feature associated with CLN7 disease, establishing it as a phenotype of the disease.
